Though night turns to dawn

The spirit lives on

Hero,

If you were not a hero before, you certainly are now! Lion's Arch is in an uproar, celebrating your victory and this new "pact" between the Orders. By the Six, you have truly shown your mettle! I knew you would be a star in the heavens, but even I did not think you would rise so soon. Well done, my friend, extremely well done.

Since I have left Kryta, I become more and more certain this was the right thing to do. So many other parts of the world are worse off than our kingdom. It is disheartening. I hear that Zojja and Eir are headed toward Dredgehaunt Cliffs (for what reason, I can't guess). In the spirit of your victory and unification of the three Orders, I've decided to set upon a journey that seems long overdue—to find Rytlock, and offer him the hand of friendship. The High Legions are once more under attack from an old enemy, the Flame Legion. Perhaps that will convince him that he still needs an old friend.

—Logan

strings.en:
Dad, 

Mom passed along your request. I've pulled some materials on Janthir, mursaat, and the titans from the archives and left them in your satchel with this letter. Please make sure they make it back to the Priory; Magister Stonehealer will have my head otherwise. 

Wish I could've gone with you, but my manipulations are rusty, and I'd just get in your way. That and my archival duties have me tied up, too. Sestina and I have been cataloguing and organizing all of the new reports and research coming in from the Janthir expeditions for printing and distribution among the alliance. Sorry, I'm rambling now. Please, just come back in one piece. 

Best of luck, 

Kurt 

PS. If you DO kill a titan, I wouldn't mind a fresh sample of its exo-shell, or one of its organs if you can sneak it out. Might be safer to do it aboveboard, though, if the smuggling rumors are true. The Priory would appreciate it!

Ai,

We made it! I am so excited to have finally stepped foot on these shores.

After a short trek up the coast, we met with the mainland forces. They are awe-inspiring, Ai. The quality of their armor...WOW! And the Royal Guard! I had heard a few things from the other soldiers, but to see them in person... I was barely able to stand straight and attentive. Someone called them the Seven Canthan Spears. Apparently they are Usoku's best women and men. I'm glad they're on our side.

OH! OH! The stories are true, Ai. The forest is BEAUTIFUL! I don't want to spoil the surprise. I wish you were here to see it. I'm going to take you and Lan on a trip as soon as I'm home.

Tell Lan I'm bringing her back one of those spears!

Just kidding.

Maybe not?
